name: T047: final alongside demand has no effect here -- demand is enforced, final is present but nothing tries to override or weaken it, so it fires no diagnostic (spec.md Acceptance Scenario 6, v0.3 FR-002's rule carried forward). Originally also asserted a per-key 'seal:' was inert -- that was the pre-v0.7 spelling, from before 'seal' moved into 'demand' (SPEC.md Sec9/Sec15); v0.7 part 2 closes the per-key vocabulary and a per-key 'seal:' is now refused as unknown-key-vocabulary-keyword (see validate-vocabulary/unknown-key-vocabulary-keyword), so it no longer belongs in a fixture about INERT vocabulary and was removed from this one. Originally also asserted 'delegate' was inert here -- withdrawn in v0.6, which is precisely when 'delegate: allow' on a granted key stops being inert (SPEC.md Sec8); see tests/corpus/cases/validate-delegation/ for delegate's own real coverage.
